```{r}
get_level <- function(id, sport) {
  resp <- request(paste0("https://statsapi.mlb.com/api/v1/people/", id, "/stats")) |>
    req_url_query(stats = "yearByYear", group = "hitting", sportId = sport) |>
    req_perform() |>
    resp_body_json(simplifyVector = TRUE)
  
  Sys.sleep(0.3)
  
  if (length(resp$stats$splits) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  resp$stats$splits[[1]] |>
    as_tibble() |>
    unpack(c(stat, team, player, league, sport), names_sep = "_")
}

reyes <- map_dfr(c(1, 11, 12, 13, 14), \(s) get_level(reyes_id, s))

reyes |> count(sport_id, sport_abbreviation)
```

```{r}
totals_by_level <- reyes |>
  mutate(across(c(stat_gamesPlayed, stat_plateAppearances, stat_atBats,
                  stat_hits, stat_doubles, stat_triples, stat_homeRuns,
                  stat_baseOnBalls, stat_strikeOuts, stat_hitByPitch,
                  stat_sacFlies, stat_totalBases, stat_rbi, stat_stolenBases),
                as.integer)) |>
  group_by(sport_id, sport_abbreviation) |>
  summarise(
    seasons = n_distinct(season),
    g   = sum(stat_gamesPlayed),
    pa  = sum(stat_plateAppearances),
    ab  = sum(stat_atBats),
    h   = sum(stat_hits),
    hr  = sum(stat_homeRuns),
    bb  = sum(stat_baseOnBalls),
    so  = sum(stat_strikeOuts),
    hbp = sum(stat_hitByPitch),
    sf  = sum(stat_sacFlies),
    tb  = sum(stat_totalBases),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    avg    = h / ab,
    obp    = (h + bb + hbp) / (ab + bb + hbp + sf),
    slg    = tb / ab,
    ops    = obp + slg,
    iso    = slg - avg,
    k_pct  = so / pa,
    bb_pct = bb / pa
  ) |>
  arrange(sport_id)

totals_by_level
```
